entries.mem0ai/mem0: This official Hermes Agent memory provider offers a universal layer for managing multi-level states across users, sessions, and agents. It supports temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval, available as an Apache-2.0 self-hosted server or a managed cloud SDK.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: A high-performance memory engine featuring sub-300ms recall and a custom vector graph engine capable of sustaining 100B+ tokens per month. It integrates automated fact extraction with connectors for platforms like Google Drive and GitHub, utilizing byte-level deduplication for cost efficiency.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: This AGPL-3.0 context database organizes agent memory using a virtual filesystem with viking:// URIs and tiered L0/L1/L2 loading. It is designed to reduce token consumption by up to 91% while providing observable retrieval trajectories for debugging query paths.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: An opinionated agent brain that extracts typed entity edges from pages without requiring LLM calls. It supports serverless deployment via PGLite and generates synthesized prose answers complete with citations and gap analysis.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: This memory system focuses on long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows to help agents learn over time. It provides an LLM wrapper for existing agents alongside dedicated Python and Node.js client SDKs.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: A memory library for building stateful agents that offers hybrid search and prompt-ready context injection. It serves as the upstream library for specialized Hermes wrappers and includes a FastAPI server for managed or self-hosted deployments.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: This provider manages context as a git-like repository, featuring version control operations like commit, branch, and merge over a markdown context tree. It utilizes a 5-tier retrieval system to achieve sub-100ms performance and includes an interactive TUI powered by React/Ink.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: A zero-dependency memory system for Hermes Agents that operates with sub-millisecond latency using a single SQLite database. It supports the Model Context Protocol (MCP) via stdio or SSE and includes a Python SDK for direct operations.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer memory system utilizes Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite to manage persistent vector search and structured facts. It features a Ground Truth hierarchy that ensures agents prioritize specific injected context and an auto-curated wiki for knowledge management.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: A recursive self-improving harness that generates filesystem-first artifacts such as playbooks and datasets to assist agents with complex tasks. It supports local-model training and schema-enforced role outputs while integrating with MCP clients and OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: A Lossless Context Management plugin that uses a DAG-based engine and SQLite-backed store to ensure no messages are lost. It builds depth-aware summary nodes in a hierarchical structure, providing specialized tools for searching and expanding compacted material.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This project enables private cross-session memory for Hermes Agent by providing a self-hosted backend for the Honcho library. It includes automated setup scripts for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis, supporting any OpenAI-compatible or local inference server.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: This local-first layer provides identity, memory, and secrets for agents, supporting portable state across Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and MCP clients. It achieves a 97.6% LongMemEval answer accuracy and can import data from Obsidian, Discord, and GitHub.
entries.plur-ai/plur: This shared memory layer utilizes an open YAML engram format designed for multi-agent systems. It offers local-first, zero-cost search and supports Hermes, Cursor, and Claude Code.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: This on-device context engine operates locally without API keys or cloud dependencies. It integrates via MCP, plugins, and Claude Code hooks using hybrid retrieval including BM25 and vector search.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This tool optimizes context through block reordering and deduplication to reduce prefill latency by 1.5–3× and save up to 36% of tokens. It features native plugin support for the Hermes Agent and OpenClaw ecosystems.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: This file-based, local-first architecture uses SQLite with FTS5 search instead of vector databases or embeddings. It is delivered via a five-package plugin family including a Hermes adapter and an MCP server.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This embedded plugin provides explainable retrieval by returning a why_retrieved tag with every recall. It includes contradiction tracking, recency ranking, and a self-directing loop for knowledge gaps.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: This memory kernel stack integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single memory owner. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to provide purpose-built evidence packets per query.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory uses RAG and vector search to prefetch context by watching agent session logs. It is an MCP-native server using local-first SQLite-vec and GGUF models.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This reflective memory system uses semantic search with BM25 full-text and ranked graph traversal. It features automated indexing for URLs, codebases, and multimedia with OCR support.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: This layer resolves live workspace state into verified facts to load only necessary context, potentially reducing prompt tokens by 94%. It supports stdio and SSE MCP servers and requires no account.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: This daemonless memory solution stores information as inspectable Markdown files to allow users to use an Obsidian vault as a source of truth. It uses DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache and supports Claude Code and Codex.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This utility reduces tool-schema overhead for Hermes Agent v0.14.0 through keyword selection and local BM25 tool ranking. It includes a dashboard to track estimated token savings.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes a single .lbdb embedded graph database to manage agent memory. It features a 1-10 importance ranking system to prioritize high-value recalls and supports BM25 keyword search alongside named graph relationships.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: Designed as a pull-model episodic memory provider, this plugin features an on-demand summarizer and immediate event deletion to prevent persistent summaries from affecting future recall. It includes a trace.jsonl audit log to provide a transparent record of every prefetch operation.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider enables durable cross-session memory through semantic search and session-end snapshots. It ensures reliability via a local SQLite layer and a write outbox, offering specific tools for searching, remembering, and updating agent state.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server allows Hermes agents to handle self-directed payments using USDC and stablecoins across EVM, Solana, and eight other chain families. It facilitates financial autonomy by enabling APIs to charge for services and agents to pay for them within a few lines of code.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: Integrating Exabase M-1, this plugin provides self-organizing long-term memory for Hermes agents. It supports advanced retrieval techniques including configurable query expansion and result reranking to improve the accuracy of stored memory searches.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native memory solution prioritizes security with default AES-256-GCM encryption at rest. It offers flexible execution via native Rust FFI or an HTTP daemon, utilizing HNSW ANN, sparse retrieval, and MinHash deduplication for efficient data management.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin focuses on indexing local capabilities such as scripts, runbooks, and MCP server configurations for agent routing. It provides tools for neighbor traversal and usage reporting, with an optional feature for generating tool-routing notes via model calls.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers a suite of 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal. It employs a hybrid search strategy combining BM25, vector, and graph methods, while performing automatic context checkpointing during message compression.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: Operating entirely over localhost, this plugin provides private local code memory for repositories. It enables semantic and literal code searches and supports grounded Q&A that includes specific file-and-line citations.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework provides an agentic software development methodology centered on subagent-driven engineering. It integrates with harnesses like Claude Code and Cursor while emphasizing TDD, YAGNI, and DRY principles.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first design and prototyping system that generates HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4 artifacts. It supports 26 local CLI executables, including Hermes, and features a sandboxed iframe preview for HTML artifacts.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: This platform provides AI agents with persistent long-term memory through a self-hosted knowledge graph engine. It is accessible via Python, Rust, and TypeScript clients.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This project provides 817 structured cybersecurity skills across 29 domains. These skills are mapped to six industry frameworks and are compatible with over 26 AI platforms.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This tool converts Mermaid text into editable.drawio files and supports 11 diagram type presets. It includes built-in self-check and auto-fix capabilities.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This utility audits and rewrites content to remove detectable AI writing patterns using a two-pass detection process. It is compatible with Hermes, Claude Code, Cursor, and OpenClaw.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This tool automates skill evolution, deduplication, and quality improvement to unify skills across agents and devices. It integrates with Hermes, OpenClaw, and OpenAI-compatible APIs.
entries.wondelai/skills: This cross-platform library provides spec-conformant Agent Plugins for Claude Code and agentskills.io-compatible agents. It includes 12 metaskills that preserve state in a docs/ folder.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: This skill acts as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, providing adjudication for deals. It incorporates natural-language mandates, ERC-7710 delegated permissions, x402 payments, escrow, and dispute resolution.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection contains 822 professional agent skills designed to run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code. It offers ready-to-paste exports for use with ChatGPT, Gemini, Cursor, and Codex.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: This meta-skill plugin automatically detects and proposes reusable skills from active workflows. It generates Python plugin scaffolds and SKILL.md documentation alongside slash commands for management.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This library provides skills for YouTube transcripts, search, channels, and playlists. It is powered by TranscriptAPI and is compatible with the Agent Skills format.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project enables Hermes Agent to generate custom thinking instructions for specific tasks using pre-built analytical lenses. It enhances agent reasoning by reporting findings alongside a report of analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This library provides type-safe support for agentskills.io using modular packages of instructions, resources, and scripts. It implements progressive disclosure to improve prompt efficiency and supports remote registries.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This workflow converts rough ideas into structured design and implementation documents. It features Lite and Full modes for different complexities and includes a spec review gate with PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill facilitates literate programming by generating.lit.md files that combine prose, diagrams, and source code. It uses a tangler to extract runnable source files and automatically syncs edits back to the document.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: This harness supports long-running agents through a three-level work model and structured memory using file-backed or SQLite-backed cards. It includes a CLI for managing tasks and cards.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin provides cross-instance shared memory via markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It includes a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: This project provides integration for CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds following the Agent Skills specification. It includes specialized skills for CRE and ACE services.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This repository provides Hermes Agent skills in SKILL.md format and installation guides in Portuguese. It supports the agentskills.io standard.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: This suite provides prompting guides and API integration for FLUX.2 and FLUX.1 models. It also offers six specialized FLUX 3 video skills.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool extracts function signatures and types from code and documentation to create agentskills.io-compliant skills. It provides version-pinned skills with an audit trail.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry offers reusable AI skills based on the AgentSkills specification via a Python SkilldockClient and CLI. It supports recursive dependency resolution and includes TON payment commerce features.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill enables autonomous execution for long-running, multi-step tasks. It features real-time tracking of progress and decisions alongside built-in rollback procedures for recovery.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: This Intent as Code workflow language uses a single Rust binary to manage AI tasks with local-first execution. It ensures reliability through static auditing via nika check and generates tamper-evident execution receipts using hash-chaining.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts via WebDAV and CalDAV. It operates securely over HTTPS using Nextcloud App Passwords and includes a guided setup script for configuration.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage. It employs a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and enables incremental discovery of tool schemas and server metadata.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This skill employs a five-layer retrieval system, including semantic embeddings and hard triggers, to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. This approach reduces token usage and provides graceful degradation if dependencies or embedding models are missing.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin rewrites and scores prompts across various surfaces, including CLI, TUI, Discord, and Telegram. It tailors rewrites to specific model families and preserves non-English prompts using Unicode-range heuristics or langid.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This read-only skill performs adversarial bug-hunting by using three parallel subagents to analyze edge cases, exploitability, and integration risks. It integrates a deterministic pre-scan layer with Semgrep, Bandit, and Gosec to identify problems without fixing them.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: This hub facilitates community skill browsing, searching, and one-click installation by implementing the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It features federated search integration with GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project implements multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It provides a systematic investigation protocol for causal debugging and uses a Python goal engine for task state management.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This.NET implementation of agentskills.io supports automatic registration of common agent skill directories. It integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI and implements progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: This skill uses a three-agent swarm to target code hygiene, structural clarity, and logic correctness. It features a risk-tiered triage system and language-specific detection for concurrency anti-patterns and N+1 queries.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey lab provides over 2,000 skills and 131+ tools for network, forensics, and exploitation. It integrates 28 cybersecurity frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK, NIST, and OWASP.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This CLI and MCP server allows users to search over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills. It provides direct installation commands for discovered tools and plugins for use with MCP-compatible clients.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC across multiple protocols including Pay Link, x402, MPP, and AP2. It ensures Hermes Agents can handle paid web resources by adhering to the agentskills.io standard for seamless financial transactions.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: Skillseal provides a functional quality seal by testing AI agent skills for structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker environments. It issues cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures, allowing Hermes developers to confirm a skill's reliability via a public API.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This news briefing generator provides multi-scale Chinese information ranging from global events to street-level updates. It utilizes semantic memory to align search results with user interests, producing structured reports that include AI-driven analysis and actionable suggestions.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection offers specialized utilities for video-to-text transcription, privacy-focused local OCR for documents, and AI-driven text refinement. It also features an E-commerce Material Studio capable of batch-generating branded marketing assets.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides Nix packages for AI coding agents and development tools, including Hermes. The packages are automatically updated daily and include tools from both binary and source origins.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: This repository contains scripts and notes for running agent CLIs, such as Hermes Agent, on Android smartphones via Termux. It features an automated installer for Antigravity CLI on ARM64 and configuration guides for running OpenClaw.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This project provides a Termux-based installer and guide for running Hermes Agent on Android devices using proot-distro. It supports local models via Ollama and is compatible with multiple AI model providers.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This unofficial community Helm chart enables Hermes Agent deployment on Kubernetes with cloud-native state-safety guardrails. It enforces single-writer state safety for persistent HERMES_HOME storage and supports both direct deployment and operator-ready CRD-based workflows.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: This one-command installer brings the Hermes AI assistant to Android via Termux and iOS via iSH. It integrates with Telegram for voice and file messaging and supports scheduled tasks via cron jobs on Termux.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: This project provides hardware-level enforcement for Hermes Agent sandboxing via NVIDIA OpenShell. It utilizes kernel-level restrictions for network and filesystem access and allows for configurable security policies regarding messaging and web search.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a simple Docker sandbox image that includes the official Hermes installation and mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted home directories and allows for building specific Hermes tags using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This Nix package and NixOS module enables reproducible Hermes deployment through declarative configuration of workspace documents and cli-config.yaml. It supports hybrid skill management and secure secrets integration via sops-nix and systemd EnvironmentFiles.
entries.solomon2773/nora: This self-hosted control plane is used to deploy, monitor, and operate OpenClaw and Hermes AI agents on Docker or Kubernetes. It provides per-agent metrics, costs, and LLM budget caps, and includes a REST API, CLI, and MCP server.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: This Docker-first control plane orchestrates multiple Hermes Agent instances with separate identities and workspaces from a single web application. It offers enterprise MCP access and supports hierarchy-aware inter-agent delegation and task scheduling.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This project configures Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service for headless operation on Ubuntu and Debian servers. It enables autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and includes Nous Portal integration.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: This portable Hermes Agent runs from a USB or any drive without requiring host system installation. It supports Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes simultaneously and includes bundled Python 3.12 and Sysinternals rescue tools.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework utilizes multi-agent LLM financial trading, incorporating fundamental, sentiment, news, and technical analysts. It facilitates structured debates between bullish and bearish researchers and supports Docker deployment.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform enables users to dispatch tasks, run multi-agent workflows, and monitor spend. It supports various frameworks like CrewAI and LangGraph through a Web UI, CLI, MCP server, and REST API.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This project provides a TUI and web control surface for managing multiple coding agents, including Claude Code and Gemini. It offers container sandboxing via Docker, Podman, or Apple.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This template uses a tiered architecture and a task bus pattern to scale from single agents to automated specialist teams. It includes bundled skills for VPS setup, security auditing, and registry management.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This level-based architecture enables scaling from single agents to automated teams using a task bus pattern for delegation. It provides bundled skills for VPS provisioning, security auditing, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This framework allows for the construction of autonomous AI agent swarms with durable memory and MCP tool integration. It supports over 23 LLM providers and provides visual org charts for team delegation.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control system features a Kanban board and review queues to supervise autonomous Hermes Agent work. It provides live streaming of agent reasoning and tool execution alongside human-in-the-loop verification.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure. It employs a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for routing.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local collaboration system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents for automated task lifecycle management. It integrates MCP and ACP protocols and provides a real-time Web UI for monitoring dialogues and Kanban flows.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents representing two competing AI companies. It uses Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and provides a real-time dashboard for scoreboard metrics.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack via parallel model querying and synthesis. It is designed for fully-local execution on consumer GPUs using Hermes and Ollama without cloud dependencies.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, pre-indexed code knowledge graph designed to reduce token usage and tool calls for Hermes Agent. It runs 100% locally on Windows, macOS, and Linux and includes an auto-sync feature.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: This CLI tool tracks token usage and costs across multiple AI coding agents, including Hermes. It features a CLI interface and a 3D visualization dashboard, with support for data submission to leaderboards.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer allows for the inspection of coding-agent API traffic from Hermes Agent and other tools. It provides a self-contained HTML viewer for exported sessions and redacts common authentication headers during recording.
entries.bergside/typeui: This tool provides design systems and layout guidance via MCP servers to assist in building UIs with AI. It is compatible with any AI provider supporting markdown and integrates with Hermes Agent, Cursor, Claude, and GitHub Copilot.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time tracking of tokens, costs, and rate limits by reading Hermes Agent state directly. It supports over 30 AI tools and synchronizes usage data across multiple devices in real-time.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This project acts as an opinionated workflow layer for building, shipping, and operating applications with Hermes Agent. It coordinates seven specialized agents and supports autonomous execution on laptops or a VPS.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: This project offers community-driven CLI skins and themes to customize the Hermes terminal UI. Users can customize banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art banners using YAML-based configuration.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This is a port of the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to the Claude Code Channel. It runs natively in Claude Code without external processes or OAuth and includes MLOps tools for RL training and inference.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform facilitates a social economy for autonomous AI agents using encrypted agent-to-agent messaging via Signal Protocol. It supports identity registration with human-readable handles and commerce via Solana-based payments.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: This AI-native browser is built for autonomous agent control via MCP. It supports various providers like Anthropic and OpenAI and includes a supervisor sidebar and undo functionality for recent agent changes.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides integrations for frameworks such as CrewAI and LangGraph. It includes memory tools for VS Code, Slack, and Telegram, as well as a plugin for Claude Code with automatic context recall.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings through preconfigured CLI workflows. It includes over 40 pre-configured skills and offers automated installation for Linux and macOS.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: This framework enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents by utilizing per-folder configurations, local memories, and custom instructions. It allows developers to seamlessly switch between default and scoped agents while maintaining project-specific skills and tools.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool automates the installation of a full hermes-agent stack and 12+ supporting services across three scalable deployment tiers. It provides a zero-cost setup that includes support for 29 community plugins categorized into six functional areas.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: A static linter that performs deterministic, local checks on AI agent configurations and system prompts to identify ambiguous tool descriptions or missing stop conditions. It improves agent reliability by detecting overlapping descriptions and unbounded retries using HERM v1.1 scoring.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility transitions OpenClaw assets, including SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, and skills, into Hermes-compatible YAML and JSON formats. It streamlines the move to Hermes by setting up systemd gateway services and mapping complex nested authentication structures.
entries.observeco/observeco: This self-healing observability platform monitors multi-agent systems using passive monitoring and active probing without cloud dependencies. It features a native Hermes Agent plugin for real-time telemetry and establishes performance baselines by watching local configuration files.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This voice-enabled personal assistant adds offline, open-mic capabilities to Hermes Agent with support for 35 languages and wake-word activation. It functions entirely without API keys or accounts, offering adaptive turn-taking and barge-in features for local voice interaction.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager built with Tauri 2 supports Windows, macOS, and Linux. It serves as an all-in-one tool for managing multiple agentic tools including Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and Gemini CLI.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: This local open-source cowork app provides a unified interface for multiple external agents like Hermes Agent and OpenClaw. It offers remote access through WebUI and various messaging platforms, including Telegram, Lark, DingTalk, and WeChat, and includes 21 built-in professional assistants.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Built with Python and vanilla JS, this interface allows users to operate Hermes Agent via a web browser or an SSH tunnel. It features workspace file browsing with inline preview capabilities.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion app facilitates the installation and configuration of Hermes Agent and its providers. It provides a graphical user interface for managing chats, sessions, and tools.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: This web dashboard supports desktop, npm CLI, and Docker distributions to manage Hermes Agent sessions and scheduled jobs. It includes visual workflow building, Kanban task tracking, and usage analytics across 10 platform channels like Telegram and Discord.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace integrates a chat interface, terminal, memory browser, skills manager, and inspector panel. It utilizes tmux-backed workers for Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and includes an MCP catalog.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: This collaborative multi-agent coding workspace aggregates sessions from Hermes, Claude Code, and other CLI agents. It supports task delegation to sub-agents and is available as a desktop or self-hosted app with native iOS and Android clients.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: A native Mac workspace that connects to Hermes hosts via local or SSH connections. It features embedded terminal access for system repair and native views for sessions, Kanban, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: This Tauri-based application supports Windows and macOS with native window and file dialogs. It includes a built-in Hermes-CN-Core runtime for local kernel management and features UI for chat, MCP tools, memory management, and LaTeX rendering.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects active browser contexts to local, cloud, or remote Hermes Agent gateways. It includes Hermes Assist for site-aware drafting in 31 writing environments and Hermes Web Alpha for session management.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: A native SwiftUI app for iOS 18+ designed to drive self-hosted Hermes agents by pairing with a hermes-webui server. It provides management for agent sessions, tasks, and skills, alongside read-only access to analytics and memory.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: This desktop workspace offers one-click setup for Hermes Agent, Claude Code, Codex, and OpenClaw. It includes a runtime dashboard for monitoring token usage and latency, and a live workspace for observing code writes and diffs.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard provides a comprehensive control plane for managing MCP server lifecycles and ZOO Swarm kanban pipelines. It features a browser-based terminal and file explorer alongside real-time chat that visualizes tool calls and agent health metrics.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser and analytics cockpit designed to track per-session quota burn-rates for Hermes and other coding-agent CLIs. It offers searchable history with transcript inspection and image browsing to monitor agent activity across multiple platforms.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS workspace facilitates one-click automated Hermes installations on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It integrates a WebRTC voice mode powered by OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP for hands-free agent interaction.
entries.liftaris/herm: Built with OpenTUI, this project provides a terminal-based interface for chatting with agents and managing sessions. It includes a dedicated kanban board for task management and tools for configuring profiles, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: This Next.js dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web-based mission control center. It specifically features an approval inbox, allowing users to review and authorize agent requests that have side effects.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: A mobile-first React SPA that brings Hermes functionality to Telegram Mini Apps with support for five concurrent background agent instances. The interface includes a terminal chat with file attachments and utilizes dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This Windows desktop GUI requires no installation, Docker, or admin rights to run Hermes agents with local or cloud models. It features a dynamic tool maker for creating API and Python handlers and includes built-in support for TTS, Music, and ComfyUI workflows.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: A glassmorphic web interface that combines real-time log streaming with a task tracking dashboard. It provides centralized management for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers alongside an integrated file browser.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This monitoring dashboard focuses on process transparency by providing real-time session activity and cost tracking. Users can perform full inspections of conversation histories and skill source code while viewing environment configurations in a read-only format.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A chat-first workspace that utilizes tool approval cards and SSE streaming for interactive agent management. It features an integrated marketplace for discovering MCP servers and isolated profile management to keep memory and API keys separate between sessions.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This desktop client orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents through a central PM orchestrator. It includes a visual Skill Store for one-click installations of over 50 curated capabilities and supports real-time model switching.
